Flare reads XRPL state via FTSO oracles
Exodus wallet added native RLUSD + XRPL support
Root Network is EVM sidechain on XRPL

edges.notes: The XRPL Foundation is part of the community that maintains the open-source XRP Ledger.
The XRPL Foundation connects the community at XRPL.org.
Sologenic DEX is an interface for the XRP Ledger DEX, facilitating trading of IOUs issued on the XRP Ledger.
The Sologenic Development Foundation Limited is the legal entity behind the Sologenic DEX interface and services.
Flare Network maintains and operates the FTSO protocol as part of its core infrastructure.
Flare Network developed and maintains the Fassets protocol for cross-chain asset integration.
Flare Network operates the Flare Data Consensus protocol for decentralized data acquisition.
Exodus integrates with Ledger hardware wallets for secure crypto management and swapping.
Exodus integrates with Trezor hardware wallets for secure crypto management and swapping.
